android.desc:
Achieve precise measurements of vinyl turntable speed (RPM) and wow by simply placing your phone on the turntable platter!
FREE & NO IN-APP PURCHASES!

Key Features:

• Save measurements for future comparisons.
• Supports a wide range of speeds: 16 ⅔, 33 ⅓, 45, and 78 RPM.
• Sleek and intuitive modern user interface.
• Calibrate your phone to ensure the most accurate RPM readings.


Measurements include:

• Vinyl record player speed, including average and minimum/maximum variations.
• Wow & Flutter detection for an in-depth analysis of turntable performance.


Download now and experience the convenience of assessing your vinyl turntable with just your phone placed on the turntable platter.

quotes.text:
